My friend David is very kind. I am happy every day. Nina usually eats bread for lunch. For example, there are fifty students in our grade this year.
Nina and David are in the same class. Nina goes to the bookstore on Monday. The gift box is big and clean. Cows give us milk.
We talk about music a lot. The spring market is not far from my home. I like my life very much.
